notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-link-lengths (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): LINK with a COMMAREA shorter than, longer than, or absent from what the callee declares; LINK to an undefined program. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: short-100
scenarios.why: LENGTH(100) to a callee declaring 500 bytes: EIBCALEN 100, the callee leaves the extension alone

scenarios.name: long-500
scenarios.why: LENGTH(500) naming a 100-byte item: the callee addresses 500 bytes of the caller's storage and writes land in the caller's WS-AFTER

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: LINK without COMMAREA: EIBCALEN 0, the callee must not touch DFHCOMMAREA
